core_obligations: Set up the square: in a presentation of the stack by a smooth groupoid, the diagonal of the presentation morphism appears as a base change of the diagonal of the stack, so that each property of the one corresponds to the same property of the other (proof lines 4093-4105)
Apply the covering criterion: the presentation morphism is smooth and surjective, so the criterion for representable morphisms applies to the diagonal (proof lines 4106-4115)
Conclude with the scheme-free statements: the corresponding equivalences for the presenting morphisms of algebraic spaces give the listed characterizations for the stack (proof lines 4116-4122)
